about: Gate for bench/plan-exec/run.mjs over corpus.json (the plan-exec workflow). A run fails when a project cannot be run or a scan stays NOT CHECKED, when any step fails, lowers a version that was installed or that an earlier step set, or names a command the harness does not run, when the plan has no run_order, or when fewer advisories are cleared than min_net_cleared_ratio ((before - after) / before over the corpus). Measured on 2026-11-23 with this harness: the 6.5.0 candidate's run_order, commands only, 281 steps, 0 failed, 0 lowering, 1,198 -> 288 (0.7595); published 6.4.0, whose rows the harness ran including its hand edits, 362 steps run, 10 failed, 8 lowering, 1,198 -> 308 (0.7429). min_net_cleared_ratio sits just under the 6.5.0 measurement; raise it to what a release measures in the change that records that run. Advisory counts drift as OSV.dev adds records for these old versions: compare a ratio, never a count.
